text: Generative AI in judicial settings is far from perfect: it can oversimplify complex judicial deliberations, reduce emotive and cognitive processes to statistical correlations, and introduce biases or interpretive errors.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Morgan A. Gray, The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Law (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5541658
